Parsing race data and preparing the archive…

Bathurst race history, brought to life

The Great Race, decoded: every available lap, every car, 1960–2025.

Built on more than two years of research, this archive brings race results, historical detail and interactive lap-by-lap position charts together—from the Phillip Island Armstrong 500 to the modern Bathurst 1000.

A two-year project, built from the record

Every chart begins with a difficult question: where was each car, lap after lap? Reconstructing the race means comparing scattered historical records, resolving gaps, and checking the sequence against the final classification. This archive brings that research together in an interactive format, so fans can follow individual cars through the race rather than only see the finishing order.

The story starts before Bathurst became the race’s home. The archive includes the 1960–1962 Armstrong 500 races at Phillip Island, preserving the often-overlooked beginnings alongside the later mountain years. Results and charts are presented according to the historical information available; research continues where lap-by-lap records are incomplete.

Privacy Policy · Terms of Service · Data & Copyright

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 30 September 2026 — Evans Motorsport / Bathurst Race History Archive

1. What we collect

This is a personal, non-commercial historical archive. We do not run user accounts, newsletters, or payment systems on this free site.

  • No personal data is required to browse. You can view all charts, results and programme covers without providing a name or email.
  • Local storage only: Your browser may store small preferences locally (e.g., last spreadsheet folder selected, last viewed year) using localStorage. This stays on your device and is never uploaded to us.
  • Server logs: Our host Netlify may log anonymised technical information (IP address, browser type, pages visited) for security and performance. These logs are retained per Netlify's policy and are not used to identify individuals.
  • No third-party trackers: We do not use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel or advertising cookies on this version. If analytics are added later, this policy will be updated.

2. Contact by email

If you email feedback.evansmotorsport@gmail.com with a correction or enquiry, we retain your email only to respond and to verify the information you provide. We do not add you to any mailing list or share your details.

3. Australian Privacy

We handle any personal information in accordance with the Australian Privacy Principles under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). As a small, independent research project, we aim to collect the minimum necessary.

4. Your choices

You can clear localStorage at any time via your browser settings. You can browse with JavaScript disabled, though interactive charts will not function.

5. Contact

Privacy questions: feedback.evansmotorsport@gmail.com

Last updated: 30 September 2026 — Bathurst Race History Archive

1. Purpose

This site is an independent, non-commercial research archive documenting the history of the Bathurst 500/1000. It is provided free for personal use, research and education.

2. Permitted use

  • Browse lap charts, results, programme covers, driver and car histories for personal research and education.
  • Link to any public page.
  • Quote small extracts (e.g., a finishing order, a single lap sequence) with clear attribution to https://evanspj70-tech.github.io/Bathurst-archive/#home and Peter Evans / Evans Motorsport.

3. Not permitted without written permission

  • Bulk scraping, automated downloading or copying of data.js, lap datasets, charts or programme cover images.
  • Republishing full lap charts, full result datasets or the programme cover gallery on another website, app, book, video or paid product.
  • Commercial use, including use in books, documentaries, paid apps, betting products or AI model training.
  • Removing or obscuring copyright notices.

For licensing enquiries (books, documentaries, media, apps), contact feedback.evansmotorsport@gmail.com. Licensing is available at fair rates.

4. No warranty

While every effort is made for accuracy, historical records are incomplete and may contain errors. Lap data for early years is reconstructed from limited sources and is marked as Researching or Results Only where appropriate. The archive is provided "as is" without warranty.

5. Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, Peter Evans / Evans Motorsport is not liable for any loss arising from use of this site or reliance on its data.

6. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of New South Wales, Australia.

Data & Copyright

Last updated: 30 September 2026

1. What is public record vs protected

Public record (not copyrighted): Historical race finishing positions, lap counts, times, car numbers, driver names, entrants — these are facts.

Protected original work © 2026 Peter Evans / Evans Motorsport: The specific compilation, arrangement and presentation of those facts, including:

  • Corrected and cross-checked race results database (1960–2026)
  • Lap-by-lap position reconstructions and lead-change calculations
  • Driver career histories, car number histories, statistical analysis
  • Design, code, visualisations and explanatory text of this site
  • Digital restoration and low-resolution presentation of programme covers (high-res originals retained)

This distinction is recognised under Australian copyright law (Copyright Act 1968): copyright protects original compilations and presentations, not underlying facts.

2. Programme covers

Official programme cover images are shown in low resolution (approx. 1200px) for historical research and criticism under fair dealing (ss 40, 41 Copyright Act). Original copyright in cover artwork remains with the original publishers, ARDC, and/or Supercars. High-resolution restored versions are available only to licensed Pro users.

If you are a rights holder and have concerns, contact us for prompt review.

3. Data sources

  • Official Bathurst 500/1000 race results — ARDC, CAMS/Motorsport Australia
  • Published race programmes 1960–2026 (private collection)
  • Autopics, Racing Car News, Australian Motor Racing Yearbooks
  • National Archives of Australia, Trove digitised newspapers
  • Driver/team records, entry lists, period race reports
  • Lap data verified against final classification and cross-checked where multiple sources exist

4. Accuracy & corrections

Some early years have incomplete lap records. These are labelled as Researching (partial data) or Results Only (no lap chart yet). If you have primary source material that can improve accuracy, please email feedback.evansmotorsport@gmail.com. Every correction is verified before inclusion.

5. How to attribute

When quoting small extracts: "Source: Peter Evans / Evans Motorsport — Bathurst Race History Archive, https://evanspj70-tech.github.io/Bathurst-archive/ — [Year] Bathurst 500/1000"
